title: 第7章 他还得谢谢咱呢！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
轰隆轰隆！

    一连几声闷雷滚过，将梁惟石从睡梦中惊醒。

    他条件反射一般从床上坐起，伸手打开床头台灯，双眼环顾卧室四周，最后将视线落在床头那本翻开的老黄历上。

    ‘二零零三年八月十一日，癸未年七月十三，星期一，今日所宜：交易、祈福、开光……’

    梁惟石长吁了口气，一颗悬着的心慢慢放了下来。

    他是真怕啊！

    真怕自己刚刚重生回来，然后眼睛一闭一睁，又穿越了过去。

    他更怕自己重生的经历，是一场荒诞不经的美梦，甚至，是一个人临死前的幻想。

    缓缓躺回床上，听着窗外嘈杂的雨声，梁惟石思绪起伏，再无半分睡意。

    公考那边他无需多虑，估计过两天就会公布总成绩，然后按部就班，体检、政审、培训一整套下来，直至正式报到，最快也是两个月后的事情了。

    虽然他不想再混官场，但也绝不会主动给余文宏那个王八蛋腾位置。

    而且现在他要说什么弃政从商，保管亲爹亲妈的混合双打能把他打得连亲爹亲妈都不认识！

    所以，这个班不妨先上着，等以后时机成熟了再离职也不迟。

    当务之急，还是想办法搞钱！

    毕竟家里欠着五万块钱的外债，日子也过得紧紧巴巴。而老家房子征迁那是两年之后的事情，远水解不了近渴。

    说到搞钱，在他的记忆里，其实还有一个能够马上致富的方法。

    只不过，这个方法需要碰运气！

    ……

    时间一晃来到了周末。

    随着夜幕降临，福民桥东侧的旧物市场，沿着道路两边摆满了形形色色的地摊。
content_en:
Boom boom!

Several muffled thunders rolled past, waking Liang Weishi from his sleep.

He sat up from the bed as a reflex, reached out to turn on the bedside table lamp, looked around the bedroom, and finally landed on the open old almanac on the bedside.

‘August 11, 2003, July 13, Guiwei Year, Monday, what’s appropriate today: trading, praying, consecration...’

Liang Weishi took a long breath, and his anxious heart slowly relaxed.

He is so scared!

I'm really afraid that I just came back from rebirth, and then I closed and opened my eyes and traveled through the past again.

He was even more afraid that his rebirth experience was an absurd dream, or even a fantasy before death.

Slowly lying back on the bed, listening to the noisy rain outside the window, Liang Weishi's thoughts were ups and downs, and he was no longer sleepy.

He doesn't need to worry too much about the public examination. It is estimated that the total results will be announced in two days, and then he will follow the steps, including physical examination, political examination, and training, until the official registration, which will be two months at the earliest.

Although he no longer wants to be involved in officialdom, he will never take the initiative to make room for that bastard Yu Wenhong.

And now he wants to say that the mixed doubles team of abandoning politics and going into business and keeping his biological parents can beat him to the point where he doesn't even know his biological parents!

Therefore, you might as well take this class first, and it won’t be too late to leave when the time is right.

The most urgent thing is to find a way to make money!

After all, the family owed 50,000 yuan in foreign debt, and life was tight.The relocation of my hometown house will happen in two years, and water from afar cannot quench my thirst for nearness.

When it comes to making money, in his memory, there is actually another way to get rich immediately.

However, this method requires luck!

…

Time flies and the weekend comes.

As night falls, the used goods market on the east side of Fumin Bridge is filled with all kinds of street stalls along both sides of the road.
title_en: Chapter 7 He still has to thank us!
